senses.gloss:
सुफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Bearing good fruit, (literally or figuratively.)
 m.
(-लः)
 1. The wood apple, (Feronia elephantium.)
 2. The pome-
granate.
 3. Jujube.
 4. A sort of bean, (Phaseolus Mungo.)
 f. (-ला)
1. Colocynth.
 2. A pumpkin-gourd.
 3. The plantain.
 4. The brown
grape.
 E. सु good, फल fruit.

सुफेन n. (-नं) Cuttle-fish-bone.
 E. सु good, फेन froth or foam.
